dataset: Will it connect? — console and monitor signal rules behind orlandu.com's connection planner
description: The signals each console can put out (stock, by official cable, or by a common modification), the inputs each Sony monitor in the collection accepts (built in, or by BKM option card), and the cable chain the arcade uses for each signal. Consoles outside the collection are described from their published specifications and common modifications, not from units on the bench.
